before-talking-to-captain-pudi-with-leve.npc: Apples, trout. Maybe some spi... Oh sorry matey, busy getting the grub together for our next voyage. If ye need anything, talk t' Captain Pudi over by the dock.

steps.npc: I wonder what jelly would be like with cooked eels? Maybe a pie of some sor... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
Crab meat would do wonders in an admir... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
Maybe some pineapple. That could enhance the flavour of a summer pi... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?

options.text: How was your last fishing trip?

steps.player: How was your last fishing trip?

steps.npc: During the trip, I was cookin' up a nice fish pie for the crew. But then a storm 'it the ship.
Water came a spewin' through the windows and with the water came some glowing fish. It flew straight into me cooking pie.
I couldn't 'elp it, I 'ad to try it... The taste was amazin'! Never 'ad anythin' like it in me life before.
Maybe one day I will make that amazing pie again.

steps.player: That sounds great. If you ever do make it again, tell me the recipe so I can make it myself please.

steps.npc: Me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!
On with me story. after trying that amazing pie, the floor boards above fell down and the ship's wheel knocked me out.
I woke up in Al Kharid with the others. Pudi and some local fisherfolk helped us out and now we're 'ere. Lots o' mouths t' feed now!

options.text: You really like cooking. Can you share any recipes with me?

steps.player: You really like cooking. Can you share any recipes with me?

steps.npc: Unfortunately for ye, me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!

steps.player: Aw, please tell me! I've always wanted to try sailor food.

steps.npc: Ye best become a sailor then.

options.text: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?

steps.player: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?

steps.npc: Ye should bring a harpoon t' fish for them harpoonfish. They be very effective against the beast.
Ye could try cooking them too. Helps 'em shoot true.

using-items-on-him-damp-egg.player: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?

using-items-on-him-damp-egg.npc: A damp egg! What a tragedy!
A fate most foul has befallen our eggy friend 'ere!
This egg, once so full o' promise, set out on an adventure t' become somethin' more...
...alas, it fell victim t' the briny depths thanks t' Tempoross. That fiend!
Perhaps a cake, this egg dreamt t' be? We shall never know, for a damp egg is only good as a solemn reminder of the things we've lost.

using-items-on-him-damp-egg.player: Wow. You really like eggs, don't you?

using-items-on-him-damp-egg.npc: Aye, they truly are the most majestic an' versatile item in the culinary world. An inspiration t' us all!

using-items-on-him-egg.player: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?

using-items-on-him-egg.npc: Oh a gloriously dry egg! What a gift!

using-items-on-him-egg.text: You give the egg to Timallus.

using-items-on-him-raw-salmon.npc: Wha' am I supposed t' do wit' a raw salmon?

using-items-on-him-raw-salmon.player: Cook and eat it, of course.

using-items-on-him-raw-salmon.npc: Do I look like some sort o' on demand chef t' ye.

using-items-on-him-raw-salmon.player: Fine, I'll take my salmon elsewhere then.

using-items-on-him-salmon.player: Would you like a freshly cooked salmon?

using-items-on-him-salmon.npc: Aye, I be very hungry today. Skipped breakfast.

using-items-on-him-salmon.text: You give the salmon to Timallus.

using-items-on-him-salmon.npc: Thanks a lot, landlubber. I appreciate it.

using-items-on-him-spooky-egg.player: What do you make of this egg?
Just looks like an egg to me...

using-items-on-him-spooky-egg.text: Cautiously, Timallus peers more closely at the egg before recoiling suddenly.

using-items-on-him-spooky-egg.npc: That there egg that ye unfortunately possess 'as a spooky soul.

using-items-on-him-spooky-egg.player: Surely an egg doesn't have a soul-

using-items-on-him-spooky-egg.npc: An omen, perhaps? Is our fight against Tempoross about t' take a turn for the worse?
Perhaps it's even bigger than that...

using-items-on-him-spooky-egg.player: Look, I was just given this egg as a trick while Trick- or-Treating. It's just a joke!

using-items-on-him-spooky-egg.npc: A cruel trick is what it be! I wouldn't trust whoever gave yet that... thing!
There be shady dealings goin' on there, me friend, mark me words!
